## CELL FACTS

Cell 木_偏财 (Wood carrying The Horizon). Persona The Horizon (偏财). Definition line: "Wide-ranging engagement, opportunity sensed at a distance". Keyword Reach, charge dynamic, poles catalyst Momentum / friction Scatter. Family function: Action. Cost dimension: opportunity sensed far off; the near things blur. Arena: horizon, wind, open road, far light, the next place. Classical portrait: wide-ranging engagement; opportunity sensed at a distance; windfall, generosity, the near things blur. Ruled domains: Opportunity, Ventures, Father. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 正财.
Element arena: Wood (trunk, branch, root, grain, growth, the forest). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Metal. structural_interaction seed: "Metal directing Wood broadly — precision ranging across living material".
- k2_overview: "Your Wood moves as the Horizon: growth that reaches for distant light. Opportunity, for you, is territory: new markets, new cities, branches extended where no one from home has grown. You expand naturally and prune reluctantly. Fortune arrives through the reaching. Roots decide how much of it you keep."
- k2_functional: "You grow toward opportunity steadily, extending reach every season without retreating."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Wide-branching","Deal-maker","Open-handed"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Opportunity":"Opportunities appear to you as open land: markets unplanted, niches unclaimed. You see fertile ground others call wilderness. Scout it, but check the soil before transplanting everything.","Ventures":"Your ventures grow in groves: several trunks sharing a root system of skills and contacts. Let each mature before seeding the next. Orchards fail from planting fever, not planting.","Father":"The father-thread runs green and rangy: reach, enterprise, restlessness, wherever a paternal figure stood. Where that reaching shaped you, keep it. Where it left no roots, plant them yourself."}

- Sibling cell 木_正财 friction row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Outgrowing a place and staying anyway is a pattern of yours, and calling it loyalty stopped being accurate a while ago. The ground you hold has long since stopped feeding you. Holding it anyway is the habit, and the habit never checks the yield."

Core element Metal, energy element Wood. Law: Metal tames Wood (金克木: the knife prunes the branch). Relative to the core the energy is the tamed, so Wood is this core's Action. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Metal core that shows Wood on the friction pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The friction pole of Wood as the Action is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in); tone by pole: reminder. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. value.text: Whatever is newest in front of you is the thing you believe in most. There is more Wood in you than you have strength behind it, so a fresh start pulls you ahead of a finish every time. Remember that you believed just as hard in the thing you left half done.

value_b.text: You are most alive in the first week of anything. Since the far option shows no flaws and the near one shows several, you reach for the far ahead of finishing the near. Keep in mind that you will meet the same flaws out there, so finishing here costs less than it looks.

value.text: Leaving for the next thing is how you stay alive. Since the next chance pulls you more than the one you promised, you take your energy with you and leave the unfinished half to your partner. Remember that you promised them the middle as well as the start.

value.text: Running several things at once feels normal to you, and one thing alone feels like being caught. Your Wood outruns the strength carrying it, which is why you keep every option open rather than let one go. Remember how thin you get, spread across all of them with only the one body.

value_b.text: You say yes to the next thing with the same ease as the first. Since every open option feels like safety, you hold ten half chances rather than one whole one. It is worth remembering that you lack the strength for one, because chances were never hard for you to find.

value.text: Your attention is divided among more things than your body keeps up with. Because letting one go feels like losing rather than choosing, you keep them all and give each a tired version of yourself. Remember that you carry the tiredness home, where it has no single cause and no single fix.

value.text: Money you have not spent feels less real to you than money already gone. Spending is how you keep life feeling open, so an easy month goes out rather than into anything that waits. Remember that you will be the person the slow month happens to.

value_b.text: You treat money as something that moves, and the moving is the point. Because money held back feels to you like life held back, you spend on today rather than save for a day you have not met. Keep in mind how early you spend the quiet months, long before you reach them.

value.text: Where money is concerned, you are quicker to give it away than to let it sit. Since spending feels like living and saving like waiting, you choose living ahead of waiting and borrow from a month you have not reached. Remember that it is you who arrives in that month, already spent.

value.text: Your money reaches the people around you before it reaches your own next month. Because giving feels better than keeping ever has, you cover their short months rather than build a shared cushion together. Remember that you spend their quiet months as well as your own.
